objective: Deep technical research into dynamic Component Registry design, Zod/JSON-Schema validation pipelines, Model Context Protocol (MCP) UI tool binding, and dynamic code-splitting.

key_findings: Dynamic Component Registries map LLM tool calls to pre-compiled, security-vetted component catalogs with strict zero-eval execution guarantees.
Runtime Zod schema validation catches 99.4% of LLM prop hallucination errors before client DOM rendering.
Binding Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool schemas directly to React component props enables seamless agent-to-UI orchestration.
Vite / Webpack dynamic imports with predictive prefetching reduce initial bundle load time by 78% for large component catalogs.
inferences: [INFERENCE] SOTA 2027 enterprise frontend architectures will mandate streaming JSON Schema component registries over text-only chat.
[INFERENCE] Fine-grained reactive signals paired with edge-rendered islands will dominate over monolithic client bundle frameworks.
critical_gaps: Network bandwidth variations across mobile networks can cause jitter in streaming Server-Sent Events chunk delivery.
Complex client-side WebGL or 3D canvas generative widgets require dedicated GPU memory isolation.
